name: Antigravity 官方额度
description: T3 额度面板里的 Antigravity 额度改由官方 CLI 的 /usage 读取：每个实例用自己的登录，不发消息、不耗 token，T3 不再直接拿 token 调接口。
author: t3-extensions

en.name: Antigravity usage via CLI
en.description: Reads Antigravity limits for T3's usage panel with the official CLI's /usage command: each instance uses its own sign-in, sends no message, spends no tokens, and T3 stops calling the API with your token.
